1 (Currently amended): A regenerative braking control system for an electrified vehicle, comprising: at least one sensor adapted to sense a front tire impact event and transmit a sensor signal responsive to the front tire impact event during vehicle braking; and a regenerative powertrain interfacing with the at least one sensor and adapted to reduce regenerative braking torque responsive to receiving the sensor signal from the at least one sensor, wherein the front tire impact event is defined as an event causing a change in the rotational speed of the front tires.

2 (Original): The system of claim 1 wherein the vehicle comprises a hybrid electric vehicle.

3 (Original): The system of claim 1 wherein the vehicle comprises a plug-in hybrid electric vehicle.

4 (Currently amended): The system of claim 1 further comprising an electrical storage facility interfacing with and adapted to store electrical power from the regenerative powertrain, wherein the electrical storage facility is a battery.

5 (Currently amended): The system of claim 1 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to apply regenerative braking torque to at least one of a front axle and a rear axle of the vehicle, wherein the regenerative braking torque is applied based on the sensor signal.

6 (Currently amended): The system of claim 5 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to reduce regenerative braking torque at the rear axle of the vehicle responsive to receiving the sensor signal from the at least one sensor, wherein the reduction of regenerative braking torque is proportional to the severity of the front tire impact event.

7 (Currently amended): The system of claim 1 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to apply regenerative braking torque to a selected one of front wheels and rear wheels of the vehicle, wherein the selection is based on the sensor signal.

8 (Currently amended): The system of claim 7 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to reduce regenerative braking torque at the rear axle of the vehicle responsive to receiving the sensor signal from the at least one sensor, wherein the reduction is based on the detected front tire impact event.

9 (Currently amended): A regenerative braking control system for an electrified vehicle, comprising: at least one of a wheel slip sensor and a vehicle motion sensor adapted to sense a front tire impact event and transmit at least one of a wheel slip sensor signal and a motion sensor signal, respectively, responsive to the front tire impact event during vehicle braking; and a regenerative powertrain interfacing with the at least one sensor and adapted to reduce regenerative braking torque responsive to receiving the at least one of a wheel slip sensor signal and a motion sensor signal from the at least one of a wheel slip sensor and a vehicle motion sensor, wherein the front tire impact event is defined as an event causing a change in the rotational speed of the front tires.

10 (Original): The system of claim 9 wherein the vehicle comprises a hybrid electric vehicle.

11 (Original): The system of claim 9 wherein the vehicle comprises a plug-in hybrid electric vehicle.

12 (Currently amended): The system of claim 9 further comprising an electrical storage facility interfacing with and adapted to store electrical power from the regenerative powertrain, wherein the electrical storage facility is a battery.

13 (Currently amended): The system of claim 9 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to apply regenerative braking torque to at least one of a front axle and a rear axle of the vehicle, wherein the regenerative braking torque is applied based on the sensor signal.

14 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to reduce regenerative braking torque at the rear axle of the vehicle responsive to receiving the sensor signal from the at least one sensor, wherein the reduction of regenerative braking torque is proportional to the severity of the front tire impact event.

15 (Currently amended): The system of claim 9 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to apply regenerative braking torque to a selected one of front wheels and rear wheels of the vehicle, wherein the selection is based on the sensor signal.

16 (Currently amended): The system of claim 15 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to reduce regenerative braking torque at the rear axle of the vehicle responsive to receiving the sensor signal from the at least one sensor, wherein the reduction is based on the detected front tire impact event.

17 (Original): A regenerative braking control method comprising, reducing application of regeneration torque if a front tire impact event is sensed.

18 (Original): The method of claim 17 further comprising sensing the front tire impact event by using wheel slip data.

19 (Original): The method of claim 17 further comprising sensing the front tire impact event by using vehicle motion data.

20 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17 wherein reducing application of regeneration torque if the front tire impact event is sensed comprises reducing application of regeneration torque at rear wheels of a vehicle if the front tire impact event is sensed, wherein the reduction is proportional to the severity of the front tire impact event.
